name: zerodha-mutual-fund-sell-outside-the-graded-window
describes: A redemption of units held well past a year from the graded scheme. The exit load is assessed and comes to nil, and the contract note says so: the profile declares an explicit [365, unbounded) band at zero, so the rule produces a 0.00 line rather than no line at all. That is the difference between the two shipped profiles — the liquid fund expresses its load as a predicate and simply drops out, producing nothing. Both are correct and they read differently, which is worth pinning rather than discovering from a customer asking why one redemption lists an exit load of zero and another lists none.
